candidates.label: Use pure typed proposal I/O: pass one immutable revision-bound invocation envelope into the component and accept one bounded proposal, diagnostic, or evidence result; expose only structured logging and cancellation observation as host imports.
candidates.ownerGate: Essays Project owner plus Essays security owner

candidates.label: Add typed host-mediated read capabilities to pure proposal I/O, allowing revision-bound queries over explicitly granted Essays artifacts through opaque handles; retain no paths, direct filesystem, database, network, browser, or secret access.
candidates.ownerGate: Essays Project owner plus Essays security owner

candidates.label: Add typed mediated tool-request envelopes to revision-bound reads; components may request allowlisted agent or browser operations, but execution remains outside Wasm and requires the normal policy, owner-approval, effect, and evidence gates.
candidates.ownerGate: Essays Project owner plus Essays security owner plus Work Owner effect-policy owner

candidates.label: Link general WASI filesystem, sockets, environment, clocks, randomness, and standard-I/O interfaces directly to ambient host resources for every extension.
rejectionReasons: Ambient host resource access contradicts the selected deny-by-default component boundary and cannot preserve per-invocation capability, revocation, evidence, and no-direct-effect invariants.

candidates.label: Defer the capability profile; the required first-vertical component host remains blocked because its WIT imports and authority boundary cannot yet be frozen.
Stop the architecture campaign while preserving the selected Wasmtime Component Model and WASI 0.2 baseline.
